turns.question: Which channel got us leads most cheaply in September 2026, and what did each lead cost?
turns.answer: Email got leads most cheaply in September 2026 (1 to 30 September), at 37.50 EUR per lead (300 EUR of ad spend over 8 leads); search was 42.07 EUR per lead and social 52.50 EUR per lead. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.

turns.question: And which channel's leads were the most expensive, at what price?
turns.answer: Social leads were the most expensive, at 52.50 EUR per lead (2,100 EUR of ad spend over 40 leads, 1 to 30 September 2026). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
